rows.status: Phase 2 registrational cohort; enrollment expected complete 2H 2026
rows.mechanism: Intravesical inactivated Streptococcus pyogenes immunopotentiator; TLR2/NOD2 agonism
rows.line: BCG-unresponsive high-risk NMIBC with CIS +/- Ta/T1
rows.orr: CR any time 23/35 (65.7%); six-month landmark CR 15/22 (68.2%)
rows.safety: No grade 3 or higher treatment-related adverse events and no related serious adverse events
rows.source: Protara ASCO GU release dated 2026-02-23; ADVANCED-2 NCT05951179; data cutoff 2026-01-28

rows.status: Phase 2 cohort complete; ADVANCED-3 registrational trial planned for 2H 2026
rows.mechanism: Intravesical inactivated Streptococcus pyogenes immunopotentiator; TLR2/NOD2 agonism
rows.line: BCG-naive high-risk NMIBC with CIS +/- Ta/T1
rows.orr: CR any time 21/29 (72.4%); six-month landmark CR 18/27 (66.7%)
rows.safety: No grade 3 or higher treatment-related adverse events and no treatment-related discontinuations
rows.source: Protara AUA release dated 2026-05-15; ADVANCED-2 NCT05951179; data cutoff 2026-04-05

rows.mechanism: Intracystic inactivated Streptococcus pyogenes immunopotentiator derived from the OK-432 master cell bank
rows.line: Pediatric macrocystic and mixed cystic lymphatic malformations
rows.n: 16 treated; 12 completed treatment; 10 evaluable at eight weeks
rows.orr: 10/12 (83%) clinical success or improvement among treatment completers; 10/10 (100%) clinical success at eight weeks
rows.cr: Not reported for the full 2026 cohort
rows.safety: TEAEs were generally mild to moderate; 1/16 (6%) had a Grade 3 TEAE and related Grade 3 TEAE; no serious TEAEs or adverse events of special interest
rows.source: STARBORN-1 ISSVA 2026 poster; NCT05871970; data cutoff 2026-04-10

rows.status: Registrational Phase 3 THRIVE-3 (seamless 2b/3 design); interim analysis expected 2H 2026
rows.mechanism: Intravenous phospholipid substrate replacement providing choline during parenteral support
rows.line: Adolescent and adult patients on long-term parenteral support when oral or enteral nutrition is inadequate
rows.n: Historical randomized study n=15; THRIVE-3 planned n=129
rows.safety: Historical 2 g/day randomized study supported biochemical and hepatic effects; current registrational safety data not yet reported
rows.source: Buchman et al., JPEN 2001, PMID 11531217; THRIVE-3 NCT06910943; Protara release dated 2026-01-07
